description: Defines constants, types, and function prototypes for the Bluetooth ticker timer subsystem in Zephyr OS, including timer status codes, configuration parameters, and API functions for managing ticker nodes and operations.

methods.name: ticker_init
methods.description: Initializes the ticker module with specified parameters and callback functions.

methods.name: ticker_is_initialized
methods.description: Checks if the ticker module is initialized for a given instance.

methods.name: ticker_trigger
methods.description: Triggers the ticker for a specific instance.

methods.name: ticker_worker
methods.description: Worker function for ticker processing.

methods.name: ticker_job
methods.description: Job function for ticker processing.

methods.name: ticker_start
methods.description: Starts a ticker node with specified timing parameters.

methods.name: ticker_start_us
methods.description: Starts a ticker node with microsecond precision timing.

methods.name: ticker_update
methods.description: Updates an existing ticker node's timing parameters.

methods.name: ticker_yield_abs
methods.description: Yields a ticker node to a specific absolute time.

methods.name: ticker_stop
methods.description: Stops a specific ticker node.

methods.name: ticker_stop_abs
methods.description: Stops a ticker node at an absolute time.

methods.name: ticker_next_slot_get
methods.description: Retrieves the next scheduled ticker slot.

methods.name: ticker_next_slot_get_ext
methods.description: Retrieves the next scheduled ticker slot with extended match options.

methods.name: ticker_job_idle_get
methods.description: Checks if the ticker job is idle.

methods.name: ticker_job_sched
methods.description: Schedules the ticker job.

methods.name: ticker_ticks_now_get
methods.description: Gets the current ticker ticks.

methods.name: ticker_ticks_diff_get
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two ticker tick counts.

methods.name: ticker_priority_set
methods.description: Sets the priority of a ticker node.

methods.name: ticker_start_ext
methods.description: Starts an extended ticker node with additional parameters.

methods.name: ticker_update_ext
methods.description: Updates an extended ticker node with additional parameters.
